title: Privacy policy
intro: UniMate is a student app for campus links, socials, and news. This policy explains what we collect and why. It is the privacy policy URL for the UniMate app on the App Store.

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: UniMate is an independent student app. It is not an official product of your university. For privacy questions, email unimate.app@proton.me.

sections.title: Information we collect
items: Device identifier. UniMate stores a device id on this install so we can create and recognise your student profile.
Study profile. University, program, year of study, and language that you choose in the app.
Role. Student, moderator, or admin, as set on the UniMate server for your account id.

News readership. When at least half of a published news card is visible in the news feed, or you open its details, UniMate counts one view per account for that article. The server stores an article-specific one-way hash to prevent duplicate counts, not your raw account id; admins can see aggregate view counts. This hash is pseudonymous data and is removed when you delete your account.
Push notifications. If you allow notifications, we store a push token so we can send news alerts to this device.

Local links. Extra Home links you add yourself stay on this device (local storage). They are not saved as part of your server profile. To show a title and icon, the app sends the link address to the UniMate server, which fetches that public web page and returns its title and icon. We do not store these requests with your profile.
Schedule. Your timetable address is saved only on this device. Schedule sign-in happens on your university's own pages inside the app; UniMate does not receive your password.
News images. Moderators and admins may attach a photo when publishing news. That image is stored so other students can see the post.
paragraphs: We do not read your mailbox, campus timetable, or Microsoft account.

sections.title: How we use it
items: Show Home buttons, social links, and news for your university and program.
Show admins how many accounts have seen each news item, counting each account once per article.
Remember your language and notification preferences.
Let moderators and admins publish content for the audiences they manage.
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal information.

sections.title: Third-party sites
paragraphs: Home buttons and social links can open university websites, Canvas, email, or other services. Those sites have their own privacy policies. UniMate is not responsible for what they collect.

sections.title: Retention and your choices
paragraphs: You can change university, year, and language in Menu. You can delete your account at any time in the app: open Menu and tap Delete profile. This removes your server-side profile data, push token and news view hashes. You can also email unimate.app@proton.me with the id shown at the bottom of Menu.

sections.title: Children
paragraphs: UniMate is made for higher-education students. It is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.

sections.title: Changes
paragraphs: If this policy changes, we will update this page and the date above.
